CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A child says, "I am better than others because I am unique." What is wrong with this idea? (1 mark)
   A. Uniqueness has no meaning
   B. Everyone is unique, so nobody is better because of it
   C. Nobody is unique
   D. Only rich children are unique

2. Which is an example of a good thought? (1 mark)
   A. I will help my mother with the dishes
   B. I will not greet anyone
   C. I will take my friend's book
   D. I hope she falls

3. What should you do before the day ends if you have quarrelled with a friend? (1 mark)
   A. Tell others lies about them
   B. Stop speaking to them
   C. Plan revenge
   D. Make peace and forgive

4. Feelings such as happiness, sadness and anger are: (1 mark)
   A. Only for adults
   B. Always sinful
   C. Never allowed
   D. Normal, but our actions must be right

5. Which number can a child in Kenya call for help, as given in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. 116
   B. 300
   C. 555
   D. 100

6. Why did Zacchaeus climb a tree? (1 mark)
   A. He was hiding from the police
   B. He was short and wanted to see Jesus
   C. He was playing
   D. He was collecting fruit

7. What should we do instead of cursing or speaking ill about others? (1 mark)
   A. Gossip
   B. Spread rumours
   C. Insult
   D. Speak well of them and bless them

8. What did Samson find later in the body of the lion? (1 mark)
   A. Bees and honey
   B. Nothing
   C. A snake
   D. Gold

9. What does the story of Samson mainly show? (1 mark)
   A. The power of lions
   B. The size of Timnah
   C. The wealth of Philistines
   D. God's power

10. What was Sarai's name changed to? (1 mark)
   A. Rebekah
   B. Rachel
   C. Leah
   D. Sarah

11. Who went with Abram to Canaan? (1 mark)
   A. Moses
   B. Joseph
   C. Sarai and Lot
   D. Isaac

12. What does the name Jesus mean? (1 mark)
   A. Gift
   B. The Lord saves
   C. Father of many
   D. Great king

13. What does the word "annunciation" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A song
   B. A journey
   C. A festival
   D. An announcement

14. Which quality of Mary should we copy? (1 mark)
   A. Greed
   B. Trust in God and humility
   C. Anger
   D. Pride

15. What was Zechariah's job? (1 mark)
   A. Fisherman
   B. Priest
   C. Tax collector
   D. Soldier

16. Which is a kind way to help a blind person? (1 mark)
   A. Move their things
   B. Laugh at them
   C. Greet them by name and offer to guide them
   D. Leave them out

17. Which quality did Bartimaeus show when he kept shouting to Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Anger
   B. Laziness
   C. Faith and persistence
   D. Pride

18. What did Jesus tell the ten men to do? (1 mark)
   A. Wash in the river
   B. Go home
   C. Pay money
   D. Go and show themselves to the priests

19. Who was the one who returned? (1 mark)
   A. A Pharisee
   B. A Roman
   C. A priest
   D. A Samaritan

20. What did Jesus ask about the other nine? (1 mark)
   A. Who healed them?
   B. Who are they?
   C. Why were they sick?
   D. Where are the other nine?

21. What does compassion mean? (1 mark)
   A. Laughing at others
   B. Feeling sorry for others and wanting to help
   C. Being angry
   D. Ignoring others

22. Which of these is an act of compassion? (1 mark)
   A. Teasing a sad friend
   B. Ignoring a lonely child
   C. Comforting a grieving friend
   D. Laughing at a friend's loss

23. Which of these is a result of revenge? (1 mark)
   A. Peace grows
   B. Friendship grows
   C. Everyone is safe
   D. The problem gets bigger

24. What did Jesus tell the man after telling the story of the Good Samaritan? (1 mark)
   A. Go and rest
   B. Go and count
   C. Go and wait
   D. Go and do likewise

25. What does the woman's search teach us about money? (1 mark)
   A. Lose it quickly
   B. Hide it always
   C. Money is unimportant
   D. Money is valuable and should be looked after

26. What does a person do when they repent, causing joy in heaven? (1 mark)
   A. To ignore sin
   B. To blame others
   C. To hide sin
   D. They are sorry for sin and turn away from it

27. Why should we obey teachers? (1 mark)
   A. To be punished
   B. For fun
   C. They guide us and help us learn
   D. They are our enemies

28. What is a good way of obeying? (1 mark)
   A. Refuse
   B. Complain
   C. Do it at once and cheerfully
   D. Do it later

29. Which verse says that God is love? (1 mark)
   A. 1 John 4:8
   B. Luke 19:5
   C. Acts 2:38
   D. Genesis 1:1

30. Which is a personal item? (1 mark)
   A. A library book
   B. The school gate
   C. A school uniform
   D. A classroom desk

31. How many disciples did Jesus choose? (1 mark)
   A. Twenty
   B. Seven
   C. Twelve
   D. Ten

32. According to Matthew 10:3, which disciple is listed together with Thaddaeus? (1 mark)
   A. Peter
   B. Andrew
   C. James son of Alphaeus
   D. Judas Iscariot

33. Which is a group that a child should not join? (1 mark)
   A. A gang that does wrong
   B. A Bible club
   C. A football team with good rules
   D. A church choir

34. Where is the Lord's Prayer found? (1 mark)
   A. John 3:16
   B. Acts 2:38
   C. Genesis 1:1
   D. Matthew 6:9-13

35. What does patience mean? (1 mark)
   A. Waiting calmly without losing your temper
   B. Rushing
   C. Being angry
   D. Refusing to wait

36. How can we grow the fruit of the Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore the Bible
   B. Only sleep
   C. Pray, read the Bible and practise
   D. Only watch TV

37. Which verses list the fruit of the Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 1:37
   B. Galatians 5:22-23
   C. Genesis 1:1
   D. John 3:16

38. The steps to a right decision are stop, think, pray and choose. Which step comes after thinking? (1 mark)
   A. Choose before praying
   B. Ask no one
   C. Pray
   D. Forget the problem

39. Who helps us to make right decisions? (1 mark)
   A. Strangers
   B. Nobody
   C. The Holy Spirit
   D. Bad friends

40. Which of these is personal information to protect? (1 mark)
   A. The weather
   B. The colour of the sky
   C. A favourite song
   D. Your home address

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Describe what happened on the road when Balaam was riding his donkey. (4 marks)

42. Explain how Genesis 1:27 and Psalm 139 help a child who feels unimportant. (5 marks)

43. Explain what the word "sole" means when we say God is the sole Creator. (3 marks)

44. Give three ways in which children can care for animals. (3 marks)

45. State three lessons that we learn from the story of Joseph interpreting the dream. (3 marks)

46. Describe four ways in which children can serve in church. (4 marks)

47. In your own words, what is a parable and why did Jesus use them? (2 marks)

48. Name the three places in the journey of Abram, in order. (2 marks)

49. Describe three steps you can follow to forgive someone. (3 marks)

50. Write the message of Luke 1:37 in your own words and describe a situation in which it can comfort a child. (4 marks)

51. State two ways of helping the kingdom of God to grow. (2 marks)

52. Name two ways of expressing thanks to people who are kind to us. (2 marks)

53. Explain how Jesus and Joseph are examples of forgiveness. (3 marks)

54. Explain Ephesians 4:26 and show how a child can apply it when a friend has hurt them. (5 marks)

55. Name two people you can tell if you are touched in a way that makes you unsafe. (2 marks)

56. Give two signs of a person with self-control. (2 marks)

57. Explain why a child should never blame themselves if they were touched wrongly, and say what they should do. (5 marks)

58. Give three ways of living a righteous life. (3 marks)

59. Explain why Zechariah was unable to speak. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Everyone is unique, so nobody is better because of it
   All people are unique and special to God, so it is not a reason to boast.

2. A — I will help my mother with the dishes
   Helping at home is a thought that leads to kindness.

3. D — Make peace and forgive
   Ephesians 4:26 says not to let the sun go down on your anger.

4. D — Normal, but our actions must be right
   Feelings themselves are not bad. What we do with them matters.

5. A — 116
   Childline Kenya can be reached free on 116.

6. B — He was short and wanted to see Jesus
   The crowd was large, and he was short.

7. D — Speak well of them and bless them
   God's people are called to bless, not curse.

8. A — Bees and honey
   Judges 14:8 says a swarm of bees and honey were there.

9. D — God's power
   The Spirit of the Lord gave Samson strength.

10. D — Sarah
   Genesis 17:15 records this.

11. C — Sarai and Lot
   Sarai his wife and Lot his nephew went with him.

12. B — The Lord saves
   Matthew 1:21 links His name to saving people from their sins.

13. D — An announcement
   The annunciation is the announcement of Jesus' birth to Mary.

14. B — Trust in God and humility
   Mary trusted God and called herself the Lord's servant.

15. B — Priest
   Luke 1:5 says he was a priest.

16. C — Greet them by name and offer to guide them
   Kindness and respect help people with disabilities.

17. C — Faith and persistence
   He believed that Jesus could help him.

18. D — Go and show themselves to the priests
   Luke 17:14 records this instruction.

19. D — A Samaritan
   The one who returned was a Samaritan.

20. D — Where are the other nine?
   Luke 17:17 records the question.

21. B — Feeling sorry for others and wanting to help
   Compassion moves us to help.

22. C — Comforting a grieving friend
   Comfort shows care.

23. D — The problem gets bigger
   Revenge starts a cycle of hurting.

24. D — Go and do likewise
   Luke 10:37 says, "Go and do likewise."

25. D — Money is valuable and should be looked after
   The woman valued her coin.

26. D — They are sorry for sin and turn away from it
   Repenting means turning back to God.

27. C — They guide us and help us learn
   Teachers care for our progress and safety.

28. C — Do it at once and cheerfully
   Obey promptly and willingly.

29. A — 1 John 4:8
   1 John 4:8 states that God is love.

30. C — A school uniform
   Personal items belong to you.

31. C — Twelve
   Matthew 10:1 speaks of twelve.

32. C — James son of Alphaeus
   Matthew 10:3 pairs James son of Alphaeus with Thaddaeus.

33. A — A gang that does wrong
   Ungodly groups lead to harm.

34. D — Matthew 6:9-13
   Matthew 6:9-13.

35. A — Waiting calmly without losing your temper
   Patience is calm waiting.

36. C — Pray, read the Bible and practise
   Practice and prayer help.

37. B — Galatians 5:22-23
   Galatians 5:22-23.

38. C — Pray
   After thinking, we pray, and then we choose.

39. C — The Holy Spirit
   The Spirit guides believers.

40. D — Your home address
   Never share your address online.

SECTION B
----
41. (4 marks)
   Answer: The angel stood in the road. The donkey turned into a field and Balaam struck her. Then she pressed against a wall and crushed his foot, and he struck her again. Then she lay down and he struck her a third time.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the angel, 1 for turning aside, 1 for the wall and foot, 1 for lying down.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: Genesis 1:27 says people are made in God's image, so every person is valuable. Psalm 139 says we are fearfully and wonderfully made, so God took great care in making us. God also knows us by name. Therefore no child is unimportant, and we should respect ourselves and others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Genesis 1:27 meaning, 1 for Psalm 139 meaning, 1 for God knowing us by name, 1 for the conclusion, 1 for a clear link to the child's feelings.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sole means only. God alone made everything. Nobody helped Him and nobody made Him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning of sole, 1 for God alone creating, 1 for no helper.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Give them food and water; protect them from harm; do not beat them; do not overload them; give them shelter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Depend on God; do not give up when life is unfair; use gifts to serve others; save for hard times.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: Sing in the choir, help clean, welcome visitors, read a verse, take the offering, help in Sunday school.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way up to 4.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: A short story used to teach a lesson about God and life. Stories are easy to remember.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for story and 1 for teaching a lesson.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: Ur, Haran, Canaan.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct places and 1 mark for the correct order.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: Calm down; think about what happened; talk to the person kindly; say I forgive you; pray.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

50. (4 marks)
   Answer: Nothing is impossible with God. It can comfort a child who is afraid before an exam or when a family member is very sick, because God can help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 for a suitable situation, 2 for explaining how it comforts.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: Good example, prayer, inviting friends to church, sharing Bible stories.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: Say thank you, write a card, help them in return.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus prayed for those who crucified Him. Joseph forgave his brothers and cared for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Jesus, 1 for Joseph, 1 for what each did.

54. (5 marks)
   Answer: Ephesians 4:26 says to be angry without sinning and not to keep the anger overnight. A child should calm down, avoid hitting or insulting, talk to the friend kindly or ask an adult to help, forgive, and pray for peace before the day ends.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning of the verse, 1 for not sinning in anger, 1 for calming down, 1 for talking or forgiving, 1 for prayer or making peace quickly.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: Parent, guardian, teacher, pastor, nurse, police officer. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid person.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: Waits turn, controls anger, shares, saves money.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

57. (5 marks)
   Answer: The person who did wrong is always guilty. A child cannot control an adult or older person who chooses to do wrong. The child should tell a trusted adult, who will believe and protect them, and can call 116 for help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the person doing wrong being guilty, 1 for the child not being to blame, 1 for telling a trusted adult, 1 for the helper protecting, 1 for the helpline.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tell the truth, obey parents, share, avoid bad company, say sorry, pray and read the Bible.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: He doubted the angel's message. The angel said that he would be silent until the baby was born because he did not believe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for doubt, 1 for the angel's words, 1 for silence until it happened.
